$comment: Context crafting (spec §6.4, step 4.7), checked by tools/lib/validate-recipes.mjs and read by src/entities/Crafting.js. No workbench: a recipe is made from the Journal's Recipes tab or by using one of its ingredients in hand (gives), or at an interactable (requires.at, effect). ingredients: { item, n } or { anyOf: [items], n } (the first carried alternative is used; an anyOf never names a key item). requires: recipeKnown (the recipe id must be in the story's recipes), at (an interactable action: made there, over a channel). maxCrafts: how many times it can ever be made (the softlock rule: the totem never eats the dinghy's paracord). consumesKey: the key items it spends, which must be exactly the key items among its ingredients (the only key-item spends in the game besides firing the signal; see tests/crafting.test.mjs).
